chose: Every visible character lives, speaking or not. A beat that names no words takes the same living layer a speaking one does, with nothing to say: it breathes, sways and bobs; its emotion is a note, the intro pulse showing 4 s and fading, never the sign held the whole beat; and it plays in its silence, a seeded chance each 4 s (LIVENESS_POLICY.quietPlayEveryMs) at the same share and length as play in a pause between words. The same open-silence play runs before a speaker's first word and after its last. A beat that keeps its character and emotion carries its pulses on from where that emotion's run began, so moving a host doesn't pulse its sign again. Under the owner's "there isn't any moment where it just stands still" and their rule that a sign shows a few seconds and fades, weighed by C1545.
options: the listener lives, with play every 4 s of silence (taken)
the listener breathes, sways and pulses but never plays
the floor alone for a listener, the sign held the whole beat, which the review ruled a still sticker
gray: How often a listener should fidget before it distracts from the speaker is taste; no check can settle it, and the owner sees it in the preview's Listening segment.
undo: Move quietPlayEveryMs, or give a wordless beat the floor again in poseOf and hostAt; record the move as a call that moves this one.
